mapper.select:
select case when exists ( select 1 from wm_stock_document where document_no like #{pattern} escape '!'
and document_type in ('PURCHASE_RECEIPT','PRODUCTION_RECEIPT','OUTSOURCE_RECEIPT', 'MATERIAL_RETURN_RECEIPT','REWORK_RECEIPT','SALES_RETURN_RECEIPT','DEFECT_RECEIPT', 'SCRAP_RECEIPT','OTHER_RECEIPT')
and document_type in ('MATERIAL_ISSUE','OTHER_ISSUE')
limit 1 ) then 1 else 0 end
